category.name: Paragraphs
category.preferred_workflow: Prefer DocumentBuilder for simple paragraph insertion and formatting, and use direct DOM traversal for counting, filtering, and structural edits. When advanced options are required, configure the appropriate SaveOptions or LoadOptions objects and verify API availability for the target library version.

strict_api_bans: Never reference namespaces or members that are not part of the official Aspose.Words API.
Do not call Run.Replace; modify Run.Text directly to preserve formatting.
canonical_patterns: Use Paragraph.ParagraphFormat for all alignment, spacing, indent, bidi, shading, outline level, and page-break settings.
Apply built-in styles via ParagraphFormat.StyleIdentifier and custom styles via ParagraphFormat.StyleName.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate only the specific paragraph or range required for the task, avoiding blanket paragraph-count assertions.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler reports missing definitions for properties such as Document.AddBidiMarks, TxtSaveOptions.ExportHeadersFooters, or StyleIdentifier.StyleSeparator.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code references members that were never implemented in the Aspose.Words library.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the call with the supported alternative (e.g., configure TxtSaveOptions.AddBidiMarks, use the Unicode unit separator character for style separators, or omit unsupported options).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the official Aspose.Words API reference for the exact version before using a property or method.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Build fails because DocumentBuilder.MoveTo or MoveToParagraph is called with an invalid number of arguments.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code supplies parameters that do not match any overload defined in the library.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the overload signatures documented for the current version, providing both paragraph index and character index for MoveToParagraph, or call MoveTo with a Node argument.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Review method signatures in the API docs and pass the required arguments exactly as specified.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Applying paragraph style to a run
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime throws ArgumentException stating that the style is not a character style when assigning a StyleIdentifier to Font.StyleIdentifier.
common_failure_patterns.cause: A paragraph-level style (e.g., Heading1) is being applied to a Run, which only accepts character styles.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Assign a character style such as StyleIdentifier.DefaultParagraphFont to the run, or leave the run with the document's default character formatting.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Distinguish between paragraph and character styles; use Font.StyleIdentifier only for character styles.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler errors appear for calls to Paragraph.GetLinesCount or other invented layout APIs.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to use methods that are not part of the Aspose.Words API for line-count or layout information.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove the unsupported call and, if line count is needed, approximate it by measuring the rendered height or by using a custom layout engine outside Aspose.Words.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Limit paragraph-related logic to properties and methods documented in the API reference.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime failures occur when the test asserts the total number of paragraphs instead of the targeted subset.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The validation logic checks the entire document rather than the specific paragraph(s) affected by the operation.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Validate only the paragraph(s) that the task modifies or queries, using precise node references.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Scope assertions to the exact nodes involved in the operation.

examples.task: Insert a new paragraph with custom text using DocumentBuilder.Writeln inside a document loop.
Insert an empty paragraph at a specific node using DocumentBuilder.InsertParagraph for precise placement.
Set paragraph alignment to center by modifying builder.CurrentParagraph.ParagraphFormat.Alignment property for the current paragraph.
Adjust paragraph line spacing to 1.5 lines by setting builder.CurrentParagraph.ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing to 1.5.
Set first line indent of a paragraph to half an inch using ParagraphFormat.FirstLineIndent property.
Apply built-in Heading1 style to the current paragraph by assigning ParagraphFormat.StyleIdentifier to StyleIdentifier.Heading1.
Apply a custom paragraph style named MyStyle by setting ParagraphFormat.StyleName property to the style name.
Use StyleIdentifier enumeration to select a locale-independent style for a paragraph, ensuring consistent formatting.
Retrieve the number of lines in a paragraph by calling Paragraph.GetLinesCount() and store the result.
Log each paragraph's line count to the console for debugging paragraph layout issues.
Insert a style separator run between two text runs to combine different paragraph styles within one paragraph.
Search document runs for StyleIdentifier.StyleSeparator to identify existing style separators for further processing.
Enable bi-directional marks before saving to plain text by setting Document.AddBidiMarks property to true.
Export a document to TXT format while preserving headers and footers by enabling ExportHeadersFooters option during save.
Export a document to TXT without headers and footers by setting ExportHeadersFooters option to false.
Load a plain-text file with DetectNumberingWithWhitespaces enabled to automatically recognize list items.
Convert detected plain-text list numbering into Word list structures after loading the document successfully.
Navigate to a specific paragraph index using DocumentBuilder.MoveToParagraph before applying formatting changes programmatically.
Modify paragraph spacing before and after by setting ParagraphFormat.SpaceBefore and SpaceAfter properties appropriately.
Set paragraph shading background color to light gray using ParagraphFormat.Shading.BackgroundPatternColor property.
Apply right-to-left paragraph direction by setting ParagraphFormat.Bidi property to true for Arabic text.
Insert an empty paragraph after a bookmark by moving the builder to the bookmark and calling InsertParagraph.
Remove all paragraphs that use a specific style identifier, such as StyleIdentifier.Quote, from the document.
Replace text within a paragraph while preserving its original formatting by using Run.Replace method.
Merge consecutive paragraphs that share identical formatting into a single paragraph to simplify document structure.
Split a long paragraph into multiple shorter paragraphs at specified character positions to improve readability.
Insert a paragraph with a page break before it by setting ParagraphFormat.PageBreakBefore property to true.
Set paragraph outline level to 2 for subheadings to ensure proper inclusion in generated table of contents.
Apply a specific paragraph style to all heading paragraphs using a style selector loop across the document.
Count the number of paragraphs that contain a given keyword and output the total count result.
Add a paragraph containing a hyperlink run and assign the built-in Hyperlink style to it.
Insert a paragraph with a field code such as DATE and format the field result using paragraph formatting.
Determine whether a paragraph resides inside a table by checking Paragraph.IsInTable property value.
Export paragraphs to plain text with line numbers prefixed by enabling line numbering option in SaveOptions.
Load a TXT file with list detection disabled and compare the resulting document's list formatting to enabled mode.

narrative.overview: The Paragraphs category covers insertion, formatting, traversal, and export of Word document paragraphs using Aspose.Words 26.10.0. Verified examples demonstrate safe DocumentBuilder usage, style-separator handling, bi-directional text options, TXT save options, and plain-text list detection.
narrative.purpose: Provide concise, reliable guidance for an AI coding assistant to generate correct C# snippets that manipulate paragraphs with Aspose.Words, ensuring only documented APIs are used and document integrity is preserved.
validation_priorities: Check that every referenced type, property, and method exists in Aspose.Words 26.10.0 before compilation.
maintenance_notes: Update the examples whenever a new Aspose.Words version introduces or deprecates API members, and verify all referenced members against the official documentation.
